decisions.quote: We replicate and extend Merchant and Gaur’s (2008) review of research on the internationalisation of non-manufacturing firms for the following 10 years (2009-2018) for five leading international business journals.
decisions.reason: The paper explicitly replicates Merchant and Gaur's (2008) quantitative stock-taking study on a new sample of articles published from 2009 to 2018 (plus an additional journal), coding 2,907 studies using Merchant and Gaur's exact classification protocol (Section 2.1, Table 2, Figure 1) and comparing the results across periods (Section 3.1) before adding a qualitative content-analysis extension.

decisions.quote: Merchant, H. & Gaur, A. (2008). Opening the ‘non-manufacturing’ envelope: The next big enterprise for international business research. Management International Review, 48(4), 379–396.
decisions.reason: Both the title and text identify Merchant and Gaur (2008) in Management International Review as the original study being replicated and extended.

decisions.quote: Overall, we find that while research on service internationalisation has increased, the field remains fragmented and lacks theoretical and conceptual development applicable to the internationalisation of services. This creates opportunities for future research.
decisions.reason: Merchant and Gaur (2008) found that IB scholarship focused predominantly on manufacturing and neglected the non-manufacturing/service sector relative to its global economic importance. In their quantitative replication across 2009-2018 (Section 3.1 and Section 5), the authors conclude that although the volume of publications on services has increased (making the landscape not quite as barren as in 2008), studies focusing solely on the non-manufacturing sector remain a paltry 13% of the sample, IB scholars still mainly focus on manufacturing firms despite services dominating the global economy, and the field remains fragmented and underdeveloped. Under the codebook, a finding treated as supported with a somewhat weaker/reduced magnitude is coded as successful.
